paper_id: Sequential Recommendation Based on Multivariate Hawkes Process Embedding With Attention
title: Sequential Recommendation Based on Multivariate Hawkes Process Embedding With Attention
motivation: 信息过载问题严峻，传统方法忽视时间信息，复杂交互关系难以捕捉
problem_framing: 用多元Hawkes过程建模时序行为序列，用注意力机制自适应融合长短时偏好
key_insight: Hawkes过程可在连续时间空间建模事件依赖，注意力可自适应权衡用户的长短期偏好权重
method_signature: MHPE-a: 嵌入层+多元Hawkes过程+注意力偏好融合
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: gowalla数据集更稀疏，注意力带来的性能提升不如lastfm显著
evidence_for_taste: prediction at t1 and t3 mainly depends on short-term preference
prediction at t2 or t4 is mostly up to long-term preference
MHPE-a can incorporate both long/short-term user preferences
influence the performance improvement achieved by attention component
thinking_moves: 将时序推荐问题重新frame为连续时间空间中的点过程建模
通过松弛正性约束允许α和μ为负值以建模抑制效应
用注意力机制替代静态加权来动态融合长短时偏好
通过负采样解决softmax计算复杂度与物品集合规模的矛盾
